extractor: read directly from the official IND page listed in source_roles
policy: Every entry quotes the official page it was read from. source_excerpt is verbatim government wording, lowercased by the normalizer. Nothing here is paraphrased into a requirement, and nothing is included that the page did not state.
not_extracted: The Blue Card salary criterion amount. IND links a separate income page; the figure changes annually and is not stated here. What IS stated — that it is higher than the highly skilled migrant criterion — is recorded.
The named Dutch employment acts an employer must not have been fined under. IND lists them running into links.
The requirements that apply to everyone. Linked, not stated.
Long-term and short-term EU mobility rules for Blue Card holders moving between member states, which IND treats as separate situations.
Fee exceptions. Only the headline € 423,00 is recorded.

requirements.label: Be a highly educated employee from outside the EU, EEA or Switzerland
requirements.source_excerpt: a european blue card is a european work and residence permit for highly educated employees from outside the european union (eu), the european economic area (eea), or switzerland .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A European Blue Card is a European work and residence permit for highly educated employees from outside the European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA), or Switzerland.

requirements.label: Meet the requirements that apply to everyone
requirements.description: IND links a separate general-requirements page, not a registered source.
requirements.source_excerpt: you meet the requirements that apply to everyone .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You meet the requirements that apply to everyone.

requirements.label: The work in the Netherlands must be highly qualified
requirements.source_excerpt: you will be doing highly qualified work in the netherlands and:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You will be doing highly qualified work in the Netherlands and:

requirements.label: A higher education diploma from a programme of at least 3 years, relevant to the profession
requirements.source_excerpt: you have a diploma of a programme in higher education. this programme was at least 3 years. the diploma is needed for the profession or sector and is appropriate for the profession or sector.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: you have a diploma of a programme in higher education. This programme was at least 3 years. The diploma is needed for the profession or sector and is appropriate for the profession or sector.

requirements.label: A foreign diploma must be evaluated by Nuffic
requirements.source_excerpt: do you have a foreign diploma? then nuffic must evaluate the diploma. this means that nuffic will examine what the foreign diploma (‘credential’) is worth in the netherlands,
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Do you have a foreign diploma? Then Nuffic must evaluate the diploma. This means that Nuffic will examine what the foreign diploma (‘credential’) is worth in the Netherlands,

requirements.label: Or 5 years of relevant experience at higher-education level — 3 years for IT roles
requirements.description: An alternative to the diploma, not an addition. The IT exception is shorter but time-bounded: 3 years within the 7 years before applying.
requirements.source_excerpt: or you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience. your work experience is at the level of a higher education diploma. are you an it manager or it professional? a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience is required during the period of 7 years before the application.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: or you have a minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience. Your work experience is at the level of a higher education diploma. Are you an IT manager or IT professional? A minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience is required during the period of 7 years before the application.

requirements.label: Meet the income requirements
requirements.description: No figure recorded: IND links a separate income page that is not a registered source, and Blue Card salary criteria change annually. See blue_card_salary_higher for what this page DOES state about it.

requirements.label: The Blue Card salary criterion is higher than the highly skilled migrant reduced criterion
requirements.description: Recorded because the two permits look interchangeable and are not. Someone choosing the Blue Card for its residency benefit needs to know the salary bar is higher.
requirements.source_excerpt: the reduced salary criterion is higher for the european blue card in comparison to the criterion for highly skilled migrants.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The reduced salary criterion is higher for the European Blue Card in comparison to the criterion for highly skilled migrants.

requirements.label: An employment contract valid for at least 6 months
requirements.source_excerpt: your employment contract is valid for at least 6 months.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employment contract is valid for at least 6 months.

requirements.label: Your employer's company must carry out economic activity
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer's company carries out economic activity.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer's company carries out economic activity.

requirements.label: Your employer must not have been fined in the past 5 years under the named employment laws
requirements.description: IND lists the specific acts in Dutch immediately after; the list is not reproduced because it runs into links.
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer has not been fined in the past 5 years for violating one of the following laws:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer has not been fined in the past 5 years for violating one of the following laws:

requirements.label: Your employer does NOT need to be an IND-recognised sponsor
requirements.description: An absence of a requirement, recorded deliberately: it is the main practical difference from the highly skilled migrant permit and the reason many employers can use this route at all.
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer does not need to be a recognised sponsor in order to apply for a european blue card. for a highly skilled migrant application, this is mandatory.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer does not need to be a recognised sponsor in order to apply for a European Blue Card. For a highly skilled migrant application, this is mandatory.

requirements.label: You or your employer may submit the application
requirements.description: Unlike the highly skilled migrant permit and the student permit, both of which only a recognised sponsor can lodge.
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer will apply to the ind for the residence permit. your employer must do this within 3 months after you travel to the netherlands. you may also apply to the ind yourself.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer will apply to the IND for the residence permit. Your employer must do this within 3 months after you travel to the Netherlands. You may also apply to the IND yourself.

requirements.label: Application fee
requirements.source_excerpt: the application costs € 423,00. for all fees and exceptions, visit our web page fees: costs of an application .
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The application costs € 423,00. For all fees and exceptions, visit our web page Fees: costs of an application.

requirements.label: May allow EU long-term residency after 2 years instead of 5
requirements.description: A benefit the permit grants, not an obligation. Recorded because it is the reason applicants choose this route over the highly skilled migrant permit.
requirements.source_excerpt: with a european blue card, you can in some cases apply for long-term eu residency after 2 years instead of 5 years.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: With a European Blue Card, you can in some cases apply for long-term EU residency after 2 years instead of 5 years.
